subject: A work around for Rattle on MS/Windows and R 2.12.0

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: A work around for Rattle on MS/Windows and R 2.12.0
parts:
Hi All,

I believe I've tracked the problem down to the zlib1.dll library in the XML package. Rattle works for me now on R 2.12.0 (32bit). If others have a chance I wonder if you would mind trying this  work around:

(Unistall R 2.12.0 and any installed versions of GTK and Delete any local R package archive in C:\Users\<username>\R\win-library\2.12 and C:\Users\<username>\.RData)

Install:

http://downloads.sourceforge.net/gtk-win/gtk2-runtime-2.22.0-2010-10-21-ash.exe
http://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/base/R-2.12.0-win.exe

Then start R:

> install.packages("rattle")
> library(XML)
> .path.package(package="XML")
> library(rattle)

That should give the attached error popup.

Exit R and browse to the location of the installed XML package (the output of the .path.package() function call above). Then browse into libs/i386/. Delete the zlib1.dll file.

Start R again:

> rattle() 

should work.....?

Regards,
Graham

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: getting back to rattle
parts:
Richard, this relates to reverting to running Rattle on R 2.11.1 on MS/Windows XP if you have attempted (but failed) to move to R 2.12.0 . Be sure to uninstall GTK2-Runtime and then install http://downloads.sourceforge.net/gladewin32/gtk-2.12.9-win32-2.exe (which you might already have in your Downloads folder if you previously ran Rattle on 2.11.1).

I understand from Tony that the workaround for 2.12.0 (removal of the zlib1.dll file from the XML package for R on MS/Windows XP) results in the XML package not being loadable into R. I don't have access to XP to test this. 

Richard, you seem to be using MS/Windows 7. Rattle (with 32 bit R) should work there after removing the zlib1.dll file from the .../lib/i386 folder of the installed XML package for R. The 64bit version of Gtk+ is not yet available.  

Regards,
Graham

On 15 November 2010 06:55, Richard Palmer <rhpa...@gmail.com> wrote:
  1. When I follow the instructions on a 64bit Windows 7 system, I get the following :

  1. I can start R and run install.packages("rattle")
  2. library(XML) does not work.  I ran install.packages("XML"").  Then
  3. library(XML) works, as does .path.package(package="XML")
  4. library(rattle) works
  5. typing rattle() at the prompt gets the message
Error in questionDialog(sprintf(Rtxt("The package '%s' is required to %s.",  : 
  could not find function "gtkMessageDialogNew"

What next?


On Wed, Nov 10, 2010 at 2:54 PM, Graham Williams <Graham....@togaware.com> wrote:
Hi All,

I believe I've tracked the problem down to the zlib1.dll library in the XML package. Rattle works for me now on R 2.12.0 (32bit). If others have a chance I wonder if you would mind trying this  work around:

(Unistall R 2.12.0 and any installed versions of GTK and Delete any local R package archive in C:\Users\<username>\R\win-library\2.12 and C:\Users\<username>\.RData)

Install:

http://downloads.sourceforge.net/gtk-win/gtk2-runtime-2.22.0-2010-10-21-ash.exe
http://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/base/R-2.12.0-win.exe

Then start R:

> install.packages("rattle")
> library(XML)
> .path.package(package="XML")
> library(rattle)

That should give the attached error popup.

Exit R and browse to the location of the installed XML package (the output of the .path.package() function call above). Then browse into libs/i386/. Delete the zlib1.dll file.

Start R again:

> rattle() 

should work.....?

Regards,
Graham
